rules.when: term.employment_type in ["PERMANENT", "CONTRACT"] && !(has(company.facts.enterprise_size_class) && company.facts.enterprise_size_class == "MICRO_OR_SMALL") && ((has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region) in rules.minimum_wage.by_region) && term.monthly_wage < rules.minimum_wage.by_region[(has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region)] && employment.service_months < 12.0
rules.message: The monthly wage (basic plus fixed allowances; where the wage is basic plus non-fixed allowances, the basic alone) of a worker with less than one year of service is below the minimum wage of the worksite (terms.facts.worksite_region, else the company region); UU 13/2003 art.88E bars paying less.
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 art.88E(1)–(2) as amended by UU 6/2023; PP 36/2021 arts.23(1)–(3), 24(1), 25 as amended by PP 51/2023 and PP 49/2025 (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021) — the UMK of the worksite, else the UMP; art.23(2): where the wage is basic plus non-fixed allowances the basic alone must reach it (`terms.monthly_wage` holds only basic plus fixed allowances). Art.24(1): the minimum binds a worker with less than one year of service; longer service follows the wage structure and scale (art.24(2)). Micro and small enterprises are outside it (art.36). Daily and hourly wages are DAILY_MINIMUM_WAGE and HOURLY_MINIMUM_WAGE.

The hours worked are still paid (art.31), so the run warns rather than refuses.

name: Wage deductions at most 50% of the wage paid

rules.when: payslip.gross + (has(payslip.lines.CLAWBACK_OVERTIME) ? -payslip.lines.CLAWBACK_OVERTIME : 0.0) > 0.0 && (has(payslip.lines.STAFF_LOAN) ? -payslip.lines.STAFF_LOAN : 0.0) + (has(payslip.lines.DEDUCTION) ? -payslip.lines.DEDUCTION : 0.0) + (has(payslip.lines.PKWT_EARLY_TERMINATION_BY_WORKER) ? -payslip.lines.PKWT_EARLY_TERMINATION_BY_WORKER : 0.0) + (has(payslip.lines.CLAWBACK_OVERTIME) ? -payslip.lines.CLAWBACK_OVERTIME : 0.0) > 0.5 * (payslip.gross + (has(payslip.lines.CLAWBACK_OVERTIME) ? -payslip.lines.CLAWBACK_OVERTIME : 0.0))
rules.message: Loan instalments, deductions, art.62 damages and recovered overpayments exceed 50% of this wage payment (PP 36/2021 art.65); the payslip is held.
rules.authority: PP 36/2021 arts.63–65: fines, damages, wage advances, rent, debts and their instalments, and recovered overpaid wages may together take at most 50% of each wage payment (art.65); contributions to the state and social security (BPJS, PPh 21) are outside it (art.64), and so is the pension offset against separation pay (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021). Here: STAFF_LOAN, DEDUCTION and CLAWBACK_OVERTIME against the gross before the clawback. The UU 13/2003 art.62 damages a resigning PKWT worker owes (PKWT_EARLY_TERMINATION_BY_WORKER) are damages within the same 50%.

rules.description: Pay the DKPTKA, USD 100 per foreign worker per month, in advance: the month’s charge falls due on its first day.
rules.authority: PP 34/2021 arts.1 angka 7, 6–7 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP342021.pdf); USD 100 per position per month, paid in advance (Kemnaker PNBP tariff, as PP 34/2021 applies it; secondary)

rules.description: Make and give each recipient paid in the month the monthly withholding slip (BPMP for a permanent employee, BP21 for a non-permanent one, BP26), including a nil withholding and the DTP incentive, by the end of the month the tax is owed.
rules.authority: PMK 168/2023 arts.19(2)–(3), 20(1)(b), 20(3) (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/dok/pmk-168-tahun-2023); PER-11/PJ/2025; PMK 105/2025 art.5(3)

name: Late wage: fine owed to the worker

rules.description: A wage paid on or after the 4th day counted from its due day (the due day being day 1) carries a fine to the worker (LATE_WAGE_FINE adhoc class): 5% a day from the 4th to the 8th day, then 1% more a day, at most 50% in a month, plus interest after a month; the wage stays due. Raised when a payslip is marked paid on or after that 4th day.
rules.authority: PP 36/2021 arts.55(1), 61(1)–(2) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021)
rules.when: has(row.paid_on) && row.paid_on != null && has(row.pay_due_date) && row.pay_due_date != null && row.pay_due_date != "" && row.paid_on >= add_days(row.pay_due_date, 3)

rules.description: A THR paid later than 7 days before the holiday carries a fine of 5% of the THR due, used for the workers’ welfare (LATE_THR_FINE adhoc class); the THR stays due. Raised when a THR entry is recorded after the deadline.

name: PKWT period ended: pay its compensation

rules.description: A fixed-term (PKWT) period that ends while the employment continues (an extension follows) owes its uang kompensasi at its end, for that period; the extension’s compensation follows when it ends. Raised by the daily tick on the last day of a CONTRACT term that is not the exit day; pay it as a PKWT_COMPENSATION entry.
rules.authority: PP 35/2021 arts.15(2), 15(4), 16 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf)

name: Foreign worker: companion, training and Indonesian language

rules.description: Appoint an Indonesian companion worker (tenaga kerja pendamping) for the foreign worker, train the companion for the position, give the foreign worker Indonesian-language training and repatriate the worker when the contract ends. Not owed for directors, commissioners, a representative-office head, foundation organs or temporary work (art.7(3)); waive it then.
rules.authority: PP 34/2021 art.7(1)–(3) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP342021.pdf); UU 13/2003 art.45 as amended by UU 6/2023

rules.description: A private company must employ persons with disabilities as at least 1% of its workers. Raised with the January run of a company of 100 or more workers (where 1% is at least one person) to check the year’s quota.
rules.authority: UU 8/2016 art.53(2) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/37251/uu-no-8-tahun-2016)

rules.description: A company employing 50 or more workers must form a bipartite cooperation body (LKS Bipartit) and register it with the manpower office. Raised with each run of such a company until the formation day is recorded (company.facts.lks_bipartit_formed_on).
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 art.106(1) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003)
rules.when: !has(company.facts.lks_bipartit_formed_on) || company.facts.lks_bipartit_formed_on == ""

rules.description: A company of 100 or more workers, or with a high hazard potential (company.facts.k3_high_hazard), must apply an occupational safety and health management system (SMK3) and keep a safety committee (P2K3). Raised with the January run to review both for the year.
rules.authority: UU 1/1970 art.10; PP 50/2012 art.5(2) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/5245/pp-no-50-tahun-2012); Permenaker PER.04/MEN/1987 art.2
rules.applies_when: headcount >= 100.0 || (company != null && has(company.facts) && has(company.facts.k3_high_hazard) && company.facts.k3_high_hazard == true)

rules.description: Every company examines its workers’ health periodically, at least once a year; a pre-employment examination precedes work (art.2). Raised with the January run.
rules.authority: UU 1/1970 art.8; Permenakertrans PER.02/MEN/1980 arts.2, 3(2) (secondary: hukumonline)

rules.description: Draw up and apply the company’s wage structure and scale, reviewed with the year’s minimum wage, and notify each worker individually of at least the scale of their own grade.
rules.authority: PP 36/2021 arts.20–22 (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021)

name: Notify a new worker of their wage scale

rules.description: Notify the new worker individually of the wage structure and scale of their grade.
rules.authority: PP 36/2021 art.21(2)–(3) (https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161909/pp-no-36-tahun-2021)

name: Termination notice short of 14 working days

rules.when: row.catalog_code == "WORK_ACCIDENT_LEAVE" && has(row.facts) && row.facts != null && has(row.facts.doctor_certificate_on) && row.facts.doctor_certificate_on != ""

rules.when: term.employment_type == "PART_TIME" && !(has(company.facts.enterprise_size_class) && company.facts.enterprise_size_class == "MICRO_OR_SMALL") && ((has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region) in rules.minimum_wage.by_region) && employment.service_months < 12.0 && has(terms.facts.hourly_wage) && terms.facts.hourly_wage < rules.minimum_wage.by_region[(has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region)] / 126.0

rules.message: A time-based PKWT, extensions included, may not run longer than 5 years from the start of the fixed-term employment; beyond that it is a PKWTT.
rules.authority: PP 35/2021 art.8(1)–(3) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP352021.pdf); UU 13/2003 art.59 as amended by UU 6/2023

name: Probation: none in a PKWT, at most 3 months

rules.when: (employee.nationality != "" && employee.nationality != "ID") && has(terms.facts.personnel_position) && terms.facts.personnel_position == true

rules.authority: PP 34/2021 art.11(1) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP342021.pdf)

rules.message: A child under 13 may not be employed; from 13 to 15 only light work under art.69, from 14 within education under art.70.
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 arts.68–70 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003)

rules.when: (employee.nationality != "" && employee.nationality != "ID") && terms.employment_type != "CONTRACT"
rules.message: A foreign worker may be employed only for a certain position and a certain time (PKWT); this term is not a PKWT.
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 art.42(4) as amended by UU 6/2023 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003); PP 34/2021 art.2

name: Weekly rest: 1 day (6-day week), 2 days (5-day week)

rules.when: work.days.exists(d, double(size(work.days.filter(x, x.worked && calendar_distance_days(x.date, d.date) >= 0.0 && calendar_distance_days(x.date, d.date) <= 6.0))) > ((has(terms.facts.working_days_per_week) && terms.facts.working_days_per_week == 6.0) ? 6.0 : 5.0))
rules.message: Fewer weekly rest days in seven consecutive days than the working-time system gives (1 for a 6-day week, 2 for a 5-day week); work on a rest day is overtime with a written order and consent.

rules.when: employee.gender == "FEMALE" && has(employee.facts.night_work_pregnancy_risk) && employee.facts.night_work_pregnancy_risk == true && work.days.exists(d, hours_between(d.intervals, "23:00", "07:00") > 0.0)
rules.message: A pregnant worker whom a doctor certifies at risk may not work between 23:00 and 07:00; the payslip is held.

name: Night work by women: food, security and transport

rules.authority: UU 13/2003 art.76(3)–(4) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003)

rules.when: employee.date_of_birth != "" && work.days.exists(d, d.worked && double(age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date)) < 18.0)

rules.authority: UU 13/2003 arts.68–71 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003)

name: Light work above 3 hours or by night (13–15)

rules.when: employee.date_of_birth != "" && work.days.exists(d, double(age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date)) < 15.0 && (d.worked_hours > 3.0 || hours_between(d.intervals, "23:00", "07:00") > 0.0))
rules.message: A child under 15 may do light work for at most 3 hours a day, by day; the payslip is held.
rules.authority: UU 13/2003 art.69(2) (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/27/undang-undang-nomor-13-tahun-2003)

name: Daily worker on 21 days or more

Customer inputs: the entity NPWP (`company.facts.npwp`) and its ID TKU (`company.facts.nitku`, else the NPWP + 000000 of the head office), the employee NIK (`employment_profile.identity_number`), passport (`employee.facts.passport_number`) for a foreign national, the job title on the terms. BP26 (bukti pemotongan PPh 26): one per non-resident and month withheld (UU 36/2008 art.26(1); PMK 168/2023 art.14), TaxObjectCode 27-100-99, deemed 100%, Rate 20 or the treaty rate. Customer inputs: the foreign TIN (`employee.facts.foreign_tin`, else the passport), the ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country (`employee.facts.bp26_country`), birth city (`employee.facts.birth_city`); name, address and birth date from the profile.

name: Sector minimum wage not configured for the worksite

rules.when: terms.employment_type in ["PERMANENT", "CONTRACT"] && !(has(company.facts) && company.facts != null && has(company.facts.enterprise_size_class) && company.facts.enterprise_size_class == "MICRO_OR_SMALL") && has(terms.facts.worksite_kbli) && terms.facts.worksite_kbli != "" && has(rules.minimum_wage.unseeded_sector) && ((has(rules.minimum_wage.unseeded_sector.areas) && rules.minimum_wage.unseeded_sector.areas.exists(c, rules.minimum_wage.unseeded_sector.areas[c].regions.exists(k, (has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region) == k || (has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region).startsWith(k + "/")) && (rules.minimum_wage.unseeded_sector.areas[c].kbli.size() == 0 || rules.minimum_wage.unseeded_sector.areas[c].kbli.exists(p, terms.facts.worksite_kbli.startsWith(p))))) || (has(rules.minimum_wage.unseeded_sector.outside_tables) && rules.minimum_wage.unseeded_sector.outside_tables == true && !(has(rules.minimum_wage.by_sector) && rules.minimum_wage.by_sector.exists(k, (has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region) == k || (has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region).startsWith(k + "/")))))
rules.message: A 2025 sector minimum wage may apply to this worker (worksite KBLI declared; it binds under one year of service, and a longer-serving wage may not fall below it): the governor’s 2025 UMSP/UMSK for this worksite’s area is not configured in this version (only Mimika and the Kalimantan Selatan UMSK of Banjarmasin and Kotabaru are) — check the decree (Permenaker 16/2024 art.7) and pay at least its rate.

rules.authority: PP 36/2021 art.35D(1) (as amended by PP 49/2025 from 2026; with Permenaker 16/2024 art.7 for 2025); UU 13/2003 arts.88E(2) and 185: a governor’s sector minimum wage binds workers under one year of service in the sectors it names. Where the decree is known but its table was not read on an official copy (tracker ID-SETTINGS-15 lists the hosts tried), the run cannot floor the wage at it, so the payslip warns instead of silently flooring the worker at the UMK. Data: `rules.minimum_wage.unseeded_sector.areas.<code>` — `regions` (a province key covers its localities), `kbli` (prefixes of terms.facts.worksite_kbli; empty = any declared KBLI), `decree`; and `outside_tables` (version 1: every worksite area without a 2025 table in `by_sector`). Seeding an area’s table in `minimum_wage.by_sector` replaces its entry. Micro and small enterprises are outside it, as the sector rows are. It warns at any length of service: under one year the sector minimum binds (art.35D), and from one year the wage of the structure and scale may not fall below it either (UU 13/2003 art.88E(2); the long-service reading of MINIMUM_WAGE_LONG_SERVICE).

name: Worksite KBLI missing where sector minimum wages are set

rules.when: terms.employment_type in ["PERMANENT", "CONTRACT"] && !(has(company.facts) && company.facts != null && has(company.facts.enterprise_size_class) && company.facts.enterprise_size_class == "MICRO_OR_SMALL") && !(has(terms.facts.worksite_kbli) && terms.facts.worksite_kbli != null && terms.facts.worksite_kbli != "") && ((has(rules.minimum_wage.by_sector) && rules.minimum_wage.by_sector.exists(k, (has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region) == k || (has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region).startsWith(k + "/"))) || (has(rules.minimum_wage.unseeded_sector) && has(rules.minimum_wage.unseeded_sector.areas) && rules.minimum_wage.unseeded_sector.areas.exists(c, rules.minimum_wage.unseeded_sector.areas[c].regions.exists(k, (has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region) == k || (has(terms.facts.worksite_region) && terms.facts.worksite_region != "" ? terms.facts.worksite_region : company.region).startsWith(k + "/")))))
rules.message: The worksite’s KBLI (terms.facts.worksite_kbli, the business-line code on the company’s NIB) is not declared, and the governor has set sector minimum wages for this worksite’s area: without it the run cannot tell whether a sector minimum binds — declare it.
rules.description: The worksite’s KBLI (terms.facts.worksite_kbli, the business-line code on the company’s NIB) is not declared, and the governor has set sector minimum wages for this worksite’s area: without it the run cannot tell whether a sector minimum binds — declare it.
rules.authority: PP 36/2021 art.35D(1) as amended by PP 49/2025 (2026; Permenaker 16/2024 art.7 for 2025): a sector minimum wage binds by the KBLI of the business line, so the sector checks (SECTOR_MINIMUM_WAGE, MINIMUM_WAGE_LONG_SERVICE, SECTOR_MINIMUM_WAGE_UNSEEDED) need terms.facts.worksite_kbli. A worksite in an area with a table in minimum_wage.by_sector, or with an unconfigured decree in minimum_wage.unseeded_sector.areas, warns while it is missing. Micro and small enterprises are outside the sector wages.
